sourceContactRepair.sourceBoundary: Only the narrow original shoe-to-floor contact fringe, following original sole contours with about 2-4 pixels of floor. No blanket, seat, furniture, room block, new raster or redrawn shadow.

observations: Pink hair, head inclination, open held book, both hands, bent legs, socks and complete shoes remain the original RGB at original placement.
Fixed blue desk book, cup, lamp, window, bench cushion, pillows and blanket remain room content.
The first broad contact polygon made a visible floor patch and was rejected; the v3 narrow sole-following original-source fringe avoids that polygon block and restores a small local contact edge.
At enlarged scale the v3 narrow shoe contact reads darker than the unpatched version; the wider original mother cast shadow is not reproduced. Primary judgment is still required.
limitations: Actual Electron runtime scene selection, failure/hide gates and continuity were not executed because this subtask is candidate assets only.
Source-contact support must be implemented by the owning runtime path before admission; this candidate does not edit that path.
Generated background is an inpainted reconstruction, not pixel-identical to the original room.

rejected.reason: Shoe contact is visibly lighter than approved mother.
Visible hard polygon block in the floor; not offered.
